Maya: Partner lab flagged recurring P99 spikes during sustained perf/W sweeps (~30m in).
Ethan: which kernel/image and rack?
Maya: raven-2026.03 + our kernel v3.2.1 on partner-rack-7 (4xA100).
Rina: any hwmon snippet?
Maya: snip:
[2026-03-21T02:14:10Z] throughput=470 tps power=720W gpu0=70C gpu1=72C p99=190ms
[2026-03-21T02:14:45Z] throughput=476 tps power=738W gpu0=74C gpu1=76C p99=550ms
Ethan: looks like thermal throttle; dmesg?
Maya: asked partner for dmesg + BMC logs; they said fan curve is conservative.
Carlos: plan: 1) reproduce locally on identical board 2) run baseline 5m preheat + 45m sweep 3) test with powercap off and kernel baseline vs patched 4) collect 1s hwmon + dmesg + clock samples.
bench-bot: queued local run id=521 model=redwood-rlhf-small seq=2048 dur=45m telemetry=on
Rina: if reproduced, we bisect narrow range: affinity commit, powercap driver, thermal tweak. Prep eng-to-eng note with repro steps and recommended fan-curve.
Maya: partner will push fan-curve update tonight and re-run. Hold marketplace perf claims until we verify stability across racks.
Ethan: agreed. Maya will update thread after local run and partner rerun.
